Every planet and moon is where it really is at the time shown. Sizes and distances are squashed so it all fits; directions are real.

Click a planet or moon to see the sky from there. Drag to look around, scroll to go higher or lower, Esc or Back to return.

Keys: Space pause, ←→ speed, N now, 1–9 look at a planet, Shift+1–9 look from it, H hide all.
